The browser resolved iOS itag 399 at 1080p plus itag 251 audio. Finite byte probes returned 206. An intentionally expired URL returned 403; the retry controller re-resolved automatically and both probes returned 206. Native adaptive playback still failed with media code 4 because the media element requests an open range.

Android itag 18 streamed directly from Googlevideo, was stored as an opaque response in Cache Storage, and played with the browser offline. The browser made zero new Googlevideo requests during strict offline playback. No media relay was used.
